name: blockchain-learning
description: Learn Blockchain from Cryptography to Smart Contracts

scripts.clean: node -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; import path from 'node:path'; const dir = 'module0-openssl-keys/generated'; if (fs.existsSync(dir)) { fs.readdirSync(dir).forEach(f => { if (f.endsWith('.txt') || f.endsWith('.bin') || f.startsWith('verify_') || f.startsWith('tampered_')) fs.unlinkSync(path.join(dir, f)); }); console.log('[Clean] Stale temporary files cleaned from generated/ folder.'); }"
scripts.clean:all: node -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; import path from 'node:path'; const dir = 'module0-openssl-keys/generated'; if (fs.existsSync(dir)) { fs.readdirSync(dir).forEach(f => fs.unlinkSync(path.join(dir, f))); console.log('[Clean] All files cleaned from generated/ folder.'); }"
